concept: Tabs are a track holding the choices, lit from above; the chosen one is a lighter pane of glass resting in the track, and it slides to the tab the reader picks.

list.why: a shallow track lit from above, with the top-lit rim and a shade under its top edge

trigger.why: unchosen tabs are text in the track, quiet so the chosen sheet is the only mark

content.why: the panel rises a few pixels and settles when its tab is chosen

data-placed.why: the sliding sheet appears once it is placed under the chosen tab

data-ready.why: the sheet only animates after its first placement, so it never flies in on load

data-state=active.why: the chosen tab is a lighter pane resting in the track, with a heavier weight, so choice is a raised object as well as a word

active.why: a press shrinks the tab slightly, as something pushed

focus-visible.why: keyboard focus draws the shared ring with its halo, visible on any scene

@media forced-colors: active.why: forced colours drop the sliding sheet, so a real system-colour border keeps the shape

transform.why: the sheet slides to the chosen tab over the hover curve and settles

inline-size.why: the sheet changes width with the slide so it fits the new label

color.why: labels change colour at the same pace the sheet arrives

@tab-in.why: the new panel rises a short distance and settles

default_to_avoid.pattern: a row of separate ringed pills with the chosen one filled blue, or an underlined tab bar (Material tabs, Bootstrap nav-pills)
default_to_avoid.why_not: separate ringed pills read as a row of buttons, each one a target of equal weight, and nothing holds them together as one choice

derivation.consequence: legibility comes from dimming and blurring the backdrop (brightness, blur) inside a smoked body thick enough that a pane reads as a slab of glass, with the scene softened behind it
derivation.form: the tabs sit in one recess carved by dimming, so they read as one control

derivation.consequence: the scene supplies the hue; the system owns no hue of its own, only white at opacities and one ink, and colour appears only where it states a status or marks a diagram
derivation.form: the chosen tab is a lighter pane of glass; the system spends no hue on choice

derivation.consequence: controls are full pills because they are held in the hand
derivation.form: the track and the chosen sheet are full pills

derivation.consequence: nothing moves on its own; every motion answers something the reader did
derivation.form: the chosen sheet slides to the tab the reader picks and settles there

derivation.consequence: selected and pressed states change shape or add a mark (a check, a ring), never only colour
derivation.form: the chosen tab is marked by a sheet behind it as well as by colour

options: A a pane sliding in a recess
variants.picked: A a pane sliding in a recess
variants.reason: A holds the choices in one carved track (P1 depth) and keeps D-009's blue for the chosen tab as the accent sheet from Button. The unselected rings D-009 named are dropped, because a row of rings reads as a row of buttons; this is logged for review. B has no edge at rest and its lens is faint in light. C is the underlined bar every web app has.

options: C A with a spectral edge
round4.reason: The user rejected the blue and showed a reference where one light from above lights every atom alike. A reads that straight: the same top rim and sheen on every surface, the white lit solid for the loud action, chosen items as lighter glass. B makes chosen items recesses, which reads as pressed-off rather than chosen. C adds a rainbow edge, a hue the system no longer owns (P1).
